Kytkentäkaavio, ei mittakaavassa. Vasemm: Circuit diagram, not to scale. On the left is the Arduino board as a box with three connections on its right edge: 5V at the top, the analogue input A0 in the middle and GND at the bottom. On the right is a vertical voltage divider: from the 5V connection a wire leads to the light-dependent resistor, drawn as a box with two light arrows pointing at it. From the light-dependent resistor's lower end the wire continues to the 10-kilohm resistor and from it to the GND connection. From the point between the light-dependent resistor and the 10-kilohm resistor a wire leads to the A0 input.
